translationGuesses: FACES: door placed on chassis 'e' (the vignette's road passes east of the footprint, road polyline x 12-13, threshold zone east); AF-03 puts its door on the LONG front face, which on the 6x4 family would be a 6-cell face, not the 4-cell east face — the two sources disagree and the vignette (current golden-site authority) won; AF-03 front is mapped to chassis 'e' for the parapet openSide reading

PARAPET OPEN SIDE: AF-03 openSide 'south' mapped via clay-room butt-join-s axis {x:0,z:+1} = +z = AF-03 front = chassis 'e' (the door/road face); read as designed overwatch over the threshold plus the stair-head arrival on that face's exterior — interpretation, not stated in code

STOREY STACK: vignette guardroom declares storeys: 2; AF-03 builds one enclosed room plus a walkable parapeted roof; modeled as storey-0 enclosed + storey-1 open-deck (the roof deck), matching AF-03 construction and the two-mass vignette read

DECK BEARING HEIGHT: deckBase in code is terrain-derived (footprintMinimumH over the crown, approx 9+crownLift depending on layout); declared here as bearingH 9+crownLiftH, an approximation the site instantiates exactly

RETREAT: the vignette's zone-exit-retreat is a terrain cell (road-far), not a building element; at chassis scope the crown-deck egress (terrain flank reaches the crown behind the defensive edge, vignette line 767) is tagged the retreat route — translator judgment

STAIR BASE: AF-03's access edge names guardroom -> roof-lookout, but the built stair starts on the exterior apron (foot x 4.2, ~0.05 wu past the plinth east edge 3.2, while declaring supportedBy guard-plinth); modeled as from 'ground' on a 1-cell apron; supportMode 'bearing-on-lower-structure' is architectureAddStair's own default for foundationBaseY == baseY (lines 1149-1151)

DOOR APPROACH: plinth top sits 1.02 wu above plan ground with no built entry step in AF-03; the approach is declared external ('site-grade'), matching the vignette where road-cut and shelf grading meet the threshold
PARAMETER PROMOTION: familyVariant is seed-derived in code (gvsSubSeed 'guard-family-layout-v67', line 453), promoted here to a declared parameter — that promotion is the probe's premise
STATION QUANTIZATION: door/window stations quantized from AF-03 world-unit stations (3.95 of 6.1; 3.05 of 6.1) onto per-family cell slots via selectByParam
